name: recipe-api
description: Owns every Cook's recipes, tags, meal plan and shopping list. Exposes CRUD for recipes (with ingredients, steps, category, tags, favorite flag and an optional photo), weekly meal-plan entries, and shopping-list generation and check-off. Stores recipe rows in its dedicated Postgres database, scoped per Cook by the signed-in caller's identity. Does not extract recipes from text or URLs — that is the import agent's job; this service only persists what it is given.
